doc.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]

chapter: Lyrics and being in the moment
title: Hip vocabulary from Lester Young and Lenny Bruce
summary: Gates credits Lester Young, Lenny Bruce and Lord Buckley for his hip lingo.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: I like the fact that in your vocabulary you still have the words “it’s a gas” “solid” that kind of stuff.

Well I’m a fan of Lester Young and his lingo, and Lenny Bruce, and Lord Buckley, and all those hipsters. They were, to me, they were funny and bright and articulate and they said a lot with a little. You know?
